summary: Project staged sidebar edits into optimistic rows without changing the observed base

replay.detail: Unknown delivery and acknowledgement retain the current staged overlay; exact request replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: Reuses v2 projected rows and existing folder and membership operations; no wire or journal format change.

compatibility.detail: Unwired Edits::project overlays the current staged step on a matching-scope complete v2 projection. Folder-first staging remains authoritative: dependent membership rows move only after fresh-base staging. Folder batches install final positions before resolving deletions, lifting descendants to the nearest surviving ancestor independently of operation order. Create and delete touch separate registers: same-batch creation never clears a delete tombstone. Missing final ancestors resolve to root, retaining raw folder positions and deleted-parent classification. Refusal restores observed rows; observation immediately stops applying completed operations, including during completion persistence. Row ordering and ancestry validation are shared with the existing projection. Names remain host decoration.

recovery.detail: Refused intent remains available for retry but cannot move rows; partial failure preserves observed folder success. Conflicting ancestry is returned as a projection error. Rust tests are written but not run during the host disk hold.
